versions.content: The switch driver shall check whether the lower layer driver, i.e. the EthTrcv provides the APIs which can be called by an upper layer module (Eth If) of the switch driver and will be forwarded to the lower layer. In case of missing APIs, the switch driver shall raise the development error ETHSWT_E_INV_API if APIs are missing in the lower layer module.
